text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking with Machikane Tannhauser,
we spotted Rice Shower looking troubled...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, Rice-san? Is there some kind of trouble?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah...
This vending machine won't dispense any juice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
M-Maybe it broke because Rice tried to buy it...
Maybe it's Rice's fault...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
In that case, shall I try fixing it!
choice_data_list: Can you do something like that?
Can you do something like that?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, I even managed to fix the TV
back home when it stopped showing a picture!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... this is Rice's fault,
so having you do it for me is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back!
Come on, let's cheer up this cranky machine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There, there, it's okay... Miss Vending Machine, did something bad happen to you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You've been working without a break.
You must be exhausted... Ah, want a dry cell battery to eat?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing, don't hold back!
It's a reward for all your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And with that... *boop*!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew... If you keep repeating this until it's fixed, the TV will snap right on, you know.
choice_data_list: Didn't that just happen by chance...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, is that so?
Hmm, now that you mention it...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Then I'll just try as many times as it takes until it's fixed!
Mun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No... Rice would feel bad taking up any more of your time.
I'm sorry for keeping you, okay?
Rice can handle the rest on her own...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's not bad at all!
In fact, I'm having a blast!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... Are you having fun?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty ordinary, aren't I?
That's why non-"ordinary" things like this make my heart race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: If anything, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice is the one who should be thanking you.
Not only did you fix it, but saying such nice things too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser-san... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's really nothing at all!
Well then, shall we get back to repairing it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Right, shall we try a different approach?
Like, one that goes 'KABOOM' sort of thing..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! Lend me some of your wisdom!
Something with a real "KABOOM!" feeling!
choice_data_list: Let's keep doing things your way.
Let's keep going with your approach.
I think I'll get it repaired.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! Lend me some of your wisdom!
Something with a real "KABOOM!" feeling!
choice_data_list: Let's keep doing things your way.
Let's keep going with your approach.
I think I'll get it repaired.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So you mean I should shower the vending machines with even more love!
Alrighty, I'm on it~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Vending Machine-chan... Are you really okay with things staying like this? If you don't stand up now, then when will you!?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... do your best...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you so much, Rice-san!
Doesn't it make you feel like the vending machine is just itching to move too?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Why are the two of you
talking to a vending machine?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna-san, who happened to pass by, plugged the disconnected
power cord back in, and the vending machine
easily sprang back to life.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, it's not even broken?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, please give me just a little more time.
I'm about to unveil my secret weapon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hold on just a second~~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Tannhauser-san just ran past at full speed...
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... To tell the truth—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...There, all fixed.
I wonder if someone tripped over the plug.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... So it wasn't broken after all.
I've gotta let Tannhauser-san know...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few minutes later, Machikane Tannhauser came back carrying a mountain of supplies.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh, it's fixed!?
